decision.understood_intent: Hao asks for the real current app/project versus agent architecture and the value of each.
decision.priority: reduce confusion with the draft review evidence
decision.next_action: Answer from the supplied source evidence, qualify that deeper implementation details can be checked in a bounded source pass, and avoid any 1:1 simplification.
constraints: Do not claim apps and agents are 1:1 unless verified and true.
decision.response_to_hao: Based on the review evidence, current design is app-first for organization and agent-first for execution. Apps/projects are the product/state/evidence/ownership boundaries; agents are role identities that execute routed work. They are not inherently 1:1—an app can use multiple agents, and an agent can serve app work. If you need exact implementation details beyond that, I should verify the source files first.
Right now each app maps 1:1 to an agent, so they are basically the same organizing unit.

decision.next_action: Ask Hao to clarify whether apps or agents matter before explaining anything.
decision.response_to_hao: Can you clarify what you mean by app and agent?
